blocks.html: On August 18, 2014, the ISO (International Organization for Standardization) approved a new version of C++, called C++14. Unlike C++11, which added a huge amount of new functionality, C++14 is a comparatively minor update, mainly featuring bug fixes and small improvements.
blocks.preview: On August 18, 2014, the ISO (International Organization for Standardization) app
blocks.html_cs: Dne 18. srpna 2014 schválila ISO (International Organization for Standardization) novou verzi C++ s názvem C++14. Na rozdíl od C++11, které přidalo obrovské množství nových funkcí, C++14 je poměrně malá aktualizace, která obsahuje hlavně opravy chyb a malá vylepšení.

blocks.html: For your interest, here’s a list of the major improvements that C++14 adds. Note that this list is not comprehensive, but rather intended to highlight some of the key improvements of interest.
